case: G1 directional margin on the simplex
claim: no direction d in the unit simplex leaves every term of nu(d) at most 2375/16384; equivalently min_{d in Delta} nu(d) > 2375/16384, where nu(d) = max_i max(g_i(d), d_i*(-g_i(d))) is the lower bound on the stationary deviation margin along the vanishing family x = t*d (docs/G1_LIMIT_LEMMA.md 3). The last coordinate is eliminated, d_4 = 1 - sum_j d_j, and the condition `simplex` is what excludes the part of the cube where that is negative. The bound is the quantitative form of `LCP(R,0) has only the trivial solution`, and it is the input the limit lemma consumes.
